import sys
from heapq import heappush, heappop

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
m = int(input[1])
a = list(map(int, input[2:]))

time = 0
current_disk_usage = 0
download_queue = []

for size in sorted(a):
    while download_queue and current_disk_usage + size > m:
        earliest_finish = heappop(download_queue)
        time = max(time, earliest_finish)
        current_disk_usage -= a.pop(0)
    heappush(download_queue, time + size)
    current_disk_usage += size
    time = max(time, download_queue[0])

print(time)
